description: Product-level deterministic simulation journeys covering economy/logistics/combat composition. Repeated textual simulation results (including the per-run `work` counter line) are the correctness gate; hosted-linux wall-clock timing is advisory. Deterministic work counters are reported by the simulator; their scaling shapes are enforced by crates/raid-defense-core/tests/scaling_contracts.rs and their reporting/determinism by crates/raid-defense-sim/tests/work_counters_report.rs.

scenarios.description: Run the balanced deterministic policy through economy growth, workers, construction, repeated waves and combat.
correctnessEvidence: byte-identical simulator report across repeated executions
full requested horizon or explicit deterministic town destruction
deterministic work counters identical across reruns

metrics.name: flow_field_rebuilds
metrics.notes: Grid-wide navigation computations (flow fields and from-scratch grid searches). Constant w.r.t. agent count under unchanged topology; topology/goal changes may rebuild per goal. Enforced by crates/raid-defense-core/tests/scaling_contracts.rs.

metrics.name: navigation_cells_visited
metrics.notes: Cells expanded by navigation rebuilds; at most one grid sweep per rebuild. Enforced by crates/raid-defense-core/tests/scaling_contracts.rs.

metrics.name: path_follow_steps
metrics.notes: Per-agent next-step lookups against retained navigation; may scale linearly with active agents.

metrics.name: target_candidate_evaluations
metrics.notes: Raider candidates examined by tower targeting; follows the local candidate set, not total raiders. Enforced by crates/raid-defense-core/tests/scaling_contracts.rs.

metrics.name: logistics_candidate_searches
metrics.notes: Worker/resource/storage/site candidates examined by logistics assignment, reported separately from path-follow work. Population scaling bound is a follow-up of #38.

metrics.name: policy_validation_probes
metrics.notes: Candidate player commands validated by the headless policy.

metrics.name: world_clones
metrics.notes: Full game-state clones/materialisations made while probing candidate commands; must be 0 (no explicit O(N) clone contract).
